pipeline: select to_jsonb(p) from pipeline_runs p where id=43
steps: select to_jsonb(s) from pipeline_steps s where pipeline_run_id=43 order by id
jobs: select to_jsonb(j)-'execution_token' from background_jobs j where related_run_id=43 or payload_json->>'pipeline_run_id'='43' order by id
dispositions: select to_jsonb(d) from market_data_session_dispositions d where pipeline_run_id=43 order by id
dds-contract: select to_jsonb(c) from ib_contracts c where ticker='DDS'
dds-lifecycle: select to_jsonb(l) from instrument_lifecycle_records l where ticker='DDS' order by observed_at
dds-recent-bars: select to_jsonb(b) from price_bars b where ticker='DDS' and bar_date>='2026-10-01' order by bar_date,what_to_show
context: select to_jsonb(c) from market_calculation_contexts c where pipeline_run_id=43
upload: select to_jsonb(u) from upload_runs u where id=43
fetch-runs: select to_jsonb(f)-'execution_token' from ib_fetch_runs f where run_id=43 order by id
fetch-items: select to_jsonb(i)-'execution_token' from ib_fetch_items i where fetch_run_id in (select id from ib_fetch_runs where run_id=43) order by id
dds-fetch-history: select to_jsonb(i)-'execution_token' from ib_fetch_items i where ticker='DDS' order by id
scopes: select to_jsonb(s) from work_scope_records s where parent_scope_id=(select scope_id from pipeline_runs where id=43) or scope_id=(select scope_id from pipeline_runs where id=43)
acquisition-plans: select to_jsonb(a) from acquisition_plan_records a where plan_id in (select acquisition_plan_id from ib_fetch_runs where run_id=43) or plan_id=(select acquisition_plan_id from pipeline_runs where id=43)
schema: select to_jsonb(c) from information_schema.columns c where table_schema='public' and (table_name like '%market%context%' or table_name like '%acquisition%' or table_name like '%fetch%' or table_name like '%scope%' or table_name like '%price_bar%') order by table_name,ordinal_position
